§ 01 · The Program

A complete
portfolio.

From foundational B1 public relations vocabulary to advanced C1 crisis and reputation discourse, every module is anchored in real-world PR scenarios — from press release writing to crisis communication, from media relations to influencer strategy. Built for use inside PR agencies, corporate communications teams, government press offices, and nonprofit communications departments.

01

Industry-anchored

Every question reflects real terminology from press briefings, crisis war rooms, and media monitoring in 2026.

02

AI & monitoring

AI-powered media monitoring, sentiment analysis, and crisis prediction run throughout the program — reflecting today's public relations industry.

03

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with executive-level performance feedback and improvement guidance after every exercise.

04

Case-led pedagogy

Mini case studies bring real PR dilemmas — media backlash, executive scandals, viral misinformation — into language learning.
